note:
STAMPED, NOT MOVED. The floor carried no `measured_at` at all, so it was a number nobody could reproduce: the guard that refuses a stamp this branch never had cannot fire on a floor with no stamp, and an unstamped floor may never have been true of any tree. Re-measured on a clean detached worktree at the stamped commit -- python odoo/tooling/architecture/naming_vocabulary.py --roots agromarin --count -- and it reads 0, equal to the floor. The count does not move; only the stamp does. A sibling floor's stamp is the SIBLING's commit, recorded through `--update --root agromarin` from a clean detached worktree of that checkout, so it resolves in the repository that was actually measured.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

The two offenders left were both mis-mapped by the naive vocabulary substitution, and both are now spelled for what they do: _assign_cfdi_to_move -> _update_move_cfdi (it writes l10n_mx_edi_cfdi_uuid on the move and imports the CFDI invoice, so _update_ is honest), and _ensure_product_levels -> _create_product_levels (it CREATES the missing abc.classification.product.level rows -- its own docstring says so -- so the map's _check_ would have been a lie). agromarin now joins design-themes at a contract of 0 rather than a debt.
